beatmastering.ir: 64. The gap: form labels.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 52 form controls have no label.

Lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

careeronestop.org: 67. The gap: AI crawler access.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 9 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

Lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
